sounds.about: strudel.json-compatible sound map; keys are sound names, values are file lists or note->file maps

vox-bank.about: word/syllable vocal bank: sound maps (flat + pitched) plus words metadata

recipes.about: catalog recipes with categories and labels (program text, run only on a user gesture)

syntax.about: syntax lessons with runnable examples (program text)

docs.about: reference and practice pages as sanitised blocks

param-shapes.about: typed parameter shapes per function, modulation ranges and canonical names

atoms.about: one namespace of atoms (atomset): typed, parameterised definitions compiled away into plain Strudel strings (docs/ATOMS.md section 10)

param-editors.about: shape -> inline editor mapping, gestures, pools; optional editor modules

control-types.about: control type declarations; optional renderer modules

visuals.about: visual declarations (global and inline); optional painter modules

hooks.about: hook defs, decorators, slots, markers, vars as a model document; opaque (function) hooks are code

components.about: library components (model documents with exports), keyed name@rev

palette-actions.about: command palette actions; declarative ops are data, run modules are code

prelude.about: module evaluated into the Strudel eval context (defines pattern functions)
